folds.title: Standing instructions
points: Each Claude Code session starts with a fresh context window.
A **CLAUDE.md** file is a note you write once.
Claude reads your standing instructions from it every session.

folds.title: Where it lives
points: **Project folder**: shared with your team.
**Home folder**: for every project you work on.
**Local version**: private, just for you.

folds.title: What to put in it
points: How to run and test the project.
Your conventions.
Things Claude could not guess.
Run `/init` to get a starter file, then refine it.

folds.title: A short CLAUDE.md
points: **Run:** `npm start`
**Test:** `npm test` before every commit.
**Style:** two-space indents.
**Avoid:** editing anything in the `vendor` folder.
folds.note: Short, specific, and things Claude could not guess.

folds.title: Keep it short
points: Aim for under 200 lines.
Longer files use more context.
And Claude follows them less reliably.

folds.title: Guidance, not rules
points: Claude treats CLAUDE.md as guidance, not a hard rule.
To block an action for certain, use a hook instead.
Claude also writes its own notes, called **auto memory**.

folds.prompt: Does it belong in CLAUDE.md? Tap the basket.
